name: A Winter Away
summary:
A Winter Away is a short, hand-drawn visual novel about a daughter duck who recently moved far away from her aging mama. Write letters back and forth! Chat with the mailbirb!

Loosely inspired by Winnie the Pooh, bitsy games, and the playwright Velina Hasu Houston, A Winter Away is the first game in a series of bite-sized visual novels set in the same cozy world.
